text: I've been covering national security and intelligence issues for a number of years, and several years ago, became interested in this group of companies that were offering this new weapon, a kind of hacking tool that could crack the iPhones that all of us carry around every day.

text: NSO was founded in Israel by three men who had done their military service, which is mandatory in Israel, came out of the military, and they realized that they could recruit from the ranks of these elite Israeli hackers who were coming out of these highly secretive units of the Israeli intelligence services at a time when cyber warfare was becoming a big deal.
